title: 第29章 是礼就收
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
将8张二星魔法卡爆裂火球装到挎兜，林奇这才唤出风铃猫出门。

    之所以留着这八张魔法卡不卖，为的就是以防万一。

    如今他体内的源力储量已经达到了二星卡徒的水准，使用一张二星魔法卡也只需耗去十分之一源力，真要遇到图谋不轨的人，哪怕对方是五星御卡师，这八张能连续引爆的二星卡，也足够让对方喝一壶。

    换作寻常御卡师，这般实用的二星魔法卡早该设为副卡，随召随用。

    可林奇不一样，他是一星卡徒，卡槽空间只有一个位置。

    风铃猫的地位是绝对不能被代替的，那就只能将这二星魔法卡当一次性卡牌使用了，反正也不贵，就价值八千卡恩而已。

    自己现在可是坐拥十二万卡恩的男人，更何况马上就要进行新一轮制卡，光万卡阁就预订了三张幻影长剑，冰冷的十五万卡恩正等着他呢。

    “客人，您来了。”

    刚踏入万卡阁，穿着执事制服的凯恩就快步迎了上来，脸上堆着热络的笑容。

    周围原本三三两两交谈的客人，见平日里一本正经的执事竟如此殷勤，看向林奇的目光都尊敬了许多。

    “不错嘛凯恩，都突破二星卡徒了。”

    链接风铃猫卡牌后，御兽卡反馈给了他敏锐的感知力，林奇能够察觉到凯恩体内的源力比上次见面时更浑厚了。

    凯恩脸上的笑意更浓，语气里带着几分感激：“托您的福！晋升见习执事后，总部给我发了张品质不错的副卡，我才侥幸突破了星级。”

    “哈哈哈，这可不是侥幸。我看你身上的福气，还不止这点呢。”

    林奇伸手拍了拍他的肩膀，径直走上二楼。

    这简单一句话，一个动作，却让凯恩心头猛地一跳。

    其实他早猜到林奇有意培养自己，只是他是万卡阁的人，始终有些犹豫。

    如今亲身体会到晋升后带来的权利与便利，林奇又隐晦地暗示他未来还有更大的机会，这份诱惑让他再也按捺不住，只觉得浑身的血液都在发烫。

    林奇在二楼雅间坐下，刚翻开桌上的卡牌图鉴，就听到房门被轻轻推开的声音。

    凯恩端着茶盘走在前面，身后还跟着一道身姿窈窕的身影，正是万卡阁的大执事菲奥娜。

    “尊贵的客人，今日光临我万卡阁，不知有什么需要我帮忙的？”

    奥娜迈着优雅的步子走近，收敛裙摆坐在林奇身旁，指尖轻轻拂过耳侧的卷发，一阵清甜的香气随着她的动作飘过来，沁人心脾。

    林奇心里瞬间警铃大作：“这娘们，不会是想色诱我吧？！我可是个还没成年的孩子啊！”

    上辈子他就是因为当舔狗而死，重活一世，早就对所谓的美色看得透彻。

    越是美丽的女人，往往藏着越致命的危险。

    更何况，他这一世虽然年幼，但也是交往过几个小女友的。虽说没有菲奥娜这般性感成熟，却也让他对女人的各种攻势有了不少免疫力。

    “大执事费心了，这次我是来买制卡材料的。毕竟我父亲是尊贵的制卡师，总不能让他亲自来做这些琐事吧？”

    林奇的态度虽然平静，但眼底的傲然却显露无疑。
content_en:
Lin Qi put 8 two-star magic cards Exploding Fireball in his shoulder bag, and then summoned the wind chime cat and went out.

    The reason why these eight magic cards are kept for sale is just in case.

    Now the source power reserve in his body has reached the level of a two-star card master. Using a two-star magic card only consumes one-tenth of the source power. If he really encounters someone with evil intentions, even if the opponent is a five-star card master, these eight two-star cards that can be detonated continuously are enough to make the opponent drink a pot.

    For an ordinary card master, such a practical two-star magic card should have been set as a secondary card and used at any time.

    But Lynch is different. He is a one-star card disciple, and there is only one slot in the card slot.

    The status of the Wind Chime Cat can never be replaced, so you can only use this two-star magic card as a one-time card. It is not expensive anyway, it is only worth 8,000 Karn.

    He is now a man with 120,000 Karns, not to mention that a new round of card production is about to begin. Wanka Pavilion alone has reserved three phantom swords, and the cold 150,000 Karns are waiting for him.

    "Guest, you are here."

    As soon as he stepped into Wanka Pavilion, Kane, wearing a deacon's uniform, walked up to him quickly with a warm smile on his face.

    The guests who were talking in twos and threes around him looked at Lin Qi with much respect when they saw that the usually serious deacon was so attentive.

    "Not bad, Kane, he has already broken through the two-star level."

    After linking the Wind Chime Cat card, the Beast Control Card gave him keen perception. Lynch was able to detect that the source of power in Kane's body was stronger than the last time they met.

    The smile on Kane's face grew wider, with a hint of gratitude in his tone: "Thanks to you! After I was promoted to trainee deacon, the headquarters sent me a high-quality secondary card, and I was lucky enough to break through the star level."

    "Hahaha, this is not a fluke. I see that your blessings are more than this."

    Lynch reached out and patted his shoulder, then walked straight to the second floor.

    This simple sentence and action made Kane's heart skip a beat.

    In fact, he had already guessed that Lin Qi intended to train him, but since he was from Wanka Pavilion, he was always hesitant.

    Now that he had personally experienced the rights and conveniences brought by promotion, Lynch also hinted that he would have greater opportunities in the future. This temptation made him unable to hold back any longer, and he felt that the blood all over his body was hot.

    Lin Qi sat down in the private room on the second floor. As soon as he opened the card book on the table, he heard the door being pushed open gently.

    Kane walked in front with a tea tray, followed by a graceful figure, it was Fiona, the Archdeacon of Wanka Pavilion.

    "Dear guest, you are here at Wanka Pavilion today. Is there anything you need my help with?"

    Ona approached with graceful steps, gathered up her skirt and sat next to Lin Qi. Her fingertips gently brushed the curly hair beside her ears. A burst of sweet fragrance drifted over with her movements, refreshing her heart.

    Lin Qi's heart suddenly sounded alarm: "This bitch, isn't she trying to seduce me?! I'm a child who's not yet an adult!"

    In his previous life, he died because of being a dog licker. When he was reborn, he had a clear understanding of the so-called beauty.

    The more beautiful a woman is, the more deadly danger she hides.

    What's more, although he was young in this life, he had had several girlfriends. Although he is not as sexy and mature as Fiona, it still makes him immune to various attacks from women.

    "Arch Deacon, I'm here to buy card-making materials. After all, my father is a distinguished card-making master. I can't let him do these trivial tasks himself, right?"

    Although Lin Qi's attitude was calm, the arrogance in his eyes was clearly revealed.
title_en: Chapter 29 Accept it as a gift
